title: Ringed-topos pullback of a flat module sheaf
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal C\prime$ be small sites, $\mathcal O,\mathcal O\prime$ sheaves of commutative rings on them, and $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C\prime)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ whose left adjoint preserves finite limits. Give a ring-sheaf homomorphism $c:u^{-1}\mathcal O\to\mathcal O\prime$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], put $u^*F=u^{-1}F\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O}\mathcal O\prime$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $F$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $u^*F$ is a flat $\mathcal O\prime$-module sheaf. No flatness of $c$ is assumed.
